name: message-timestamps
description: Shows when each message was sent and how long Claude took to answer, with a line marking each new day. Works in the desktop app and the terminal, with a 24- or 12-hour clock.

language.title: Language
language.description: How dates are written: English (2 Oct), Italiano (2 ott) or 中文 (10月2日)

reply_time.title: Where Claude's time goes
reply_time.description: At the bottom right of Claude's answer, or on its own line under it

reply_duration.title: How long Claude took
reply_duration.description: After the time on Claude's answer, show how long it took from your message (08:05 · 2m 14s)

day_separators.title: Day separators
day_separators.description: Above the first message of a new day, a line naming the day (── Yesterday ──)

prompt_time.title: Where the time on your messages goes
prompt_time.description: In the desktop app: on hover, beside the app's "Just now" label, or always, on its own line above the message

hover_time.title: Time on your messages
hover_time.description: In the desktop app, show the time on your own messages, on hover or above them depending on the setting above
